additional_info.subject: RE: 0406790 - ID0406790-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / P3 170000362] Charger offline on SCB CRM:02023000510
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Elektro Vieweg GmbH & Co. KG
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P3 170000362
Charger ID/Serial No.:
mW8Dro
Problem Description:
Charger offline on SCB
Unfortunately, we cannot do much remotely when there is no SCB connection. The best approach would be to have someone on-site to check:
Whether the router is connected to the internet.
Whether the charger is powered on.
Additionally, please refer to the following points that might be causing the charger to go offline on SCB:
Possible Causes:
1. Internet Issues with Siemens Router
Due to failover functionality, the WAN may have switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
2. Mobile Network Issues
Data service of the mobile network operator may not be available.
The SIM card might be disabled or expired. (Please check by reinserting it into the XF3 and XF4 router after cleaning.)
Monthly data volume may have been exhausted.
Signal strength may have weakened due to changes in radio transmission conditions.
For M2M contracts, IP functionality may not be enabled.
3. Backend-Related Issues
The backend may have changed settings for the affected charger.
The OCPP server on the backend may be unavailable.
4. Teltonika Router Issues
The router may have switched to an incorrect network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Hardware failure of the router.
Router software crash.
Recommended Actions:
During the intervention, please carry a spare router, Ethernet cable, and SIM card in case replacements are needed.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
3/8/2024
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
